opening: You remember that Tokyo teammate from last time, the one who clicked the link that didn't exist thirty seconds ago? Here's the part of that sorcery we didn't unpack. Thirty days later, that same link still works exactly the same way. It didn't rot when you pushed to production. Your latest bugs never reached it.
